state:
- The twofold dihydroorotate rise, 40 percent UTP fall, threefold free-exposure margin, half-brequinar effect, 3 SD of a six-sample pilot, and six-of-eight rule are author-chosen cutoffs written as locked requirements, and the packet itself has no S4 effect size for that SD rule to replace. Label each number as a pre-registered operating characteristic, cite the unbound-Cmax and protein-binding sources before applying the margin, and set a fixed absolute increment on both maturation scores.
- The claimed biological context is any primary sample under two baseline maturation gates, while NPM1, FLT3-ITD, and TP53 are only logged, so a six-of-eight pass has no single differentiation-blockade population. Pre-specify one genotype-plus-phenotype context as the primary claim and give every other genotype its own falsifying count.
- The cytarabine-residual bridge stays outside the runnable assay, and the free-Cmax cap lacks a serum, plasma, or albumin matrix for a highly protein-bound drug, so cultured free drug can diverge from the approved-dose exposure. Restrict the success rule to uridine-reversible, metabolite-matched maturation versus the venetoclax–azacitidine oxygen-consumption arm, and state the protein-matched medium plus the marrow-free-drug method inside the go/no-go.
